name: agasthy
description: Read-only machine intelligence for coding agents: repos, runtimes, packages, ports, agent sessions and token cost.
long_description: AGASTHY's read-only MCP server lets coding agents ask about the developer machine with real data: search repositories, applications, runtimes, packages, tools and MCP servers; see what breaks before removing a package or runtime; list live coding-agent sessions and the processes and ports they left running; and read token usage and estimated cost from the agents' own local logs (counters only, never message text). Every tool is read-only. Most queries use the data scanned by the AGASTHY desktop app; processes, telemetry, agents and token usage work without it.
